summary: Map edges examined and rejected in round 2 on perfection and primacy. (1) STMT-PARTICIPATED-HAS-OTHER-CAUSE -> STMT-PERFECTION-CAUSED-IN-ANOTHER-IS-RECEIVED-IN-IT: wrong direction (participation to being caused, not caused to participated) and esse-only. (2) Effect depends on its cause + transitivity + irreflexivity of dependence -> efficient cause not dependent on effect: valid, but irreflexivity contradicts the counterfactual sense of DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING, under which a thing trivially depends on itself; replaced by asymmetry among distinct beings. (3) STMT-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-IS-PRIOR-TO-EFFECT -> nonmutual dependence suffices for priority: efficient priority covers only efficiently caused pairs, and is itself derived from the target. (4) STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-CAUSES-ALL-BEINGS -> others than the primary are creatures: circular in content with QUARTA-VIA-ATTRIBUTION-GENUS-PRINCIPLE-AT-BEING, and needs maximality of p and every other thing's being in act of esse. (5) STMT-BEING-GRADED-BY-APPROACH-TO-A-PRIMARY -> strict primacy: the tantum-quantum biconditional allows ties with the primary (existing omission countermodels of QUARTA-VIA-ATTRIBUTION-UNIQUE-MAXIMUM). (6) STMT-ALL-PERFECTIONS-PERTAIN-TO-PERFECTION-OF-BEING -> STMT-PERFECTIONS-ARE-MODES-OF-BEING: no Lean declaration; recorded as a supports relation. (7) Perfections are modes of being alone -> universal cause transfers perfections: the non-concurrent profile of the CausalPerfectionTransfer roles has a universal existential source that does not cause the producer's skill; the total-cause step carries the derivation. Rejection records that the leads were examined; it neither refutes nor establishes any target.
